description: Turns off one watch on the linked SupaPark account, by watch id, and returns its client label; or every cell of a watch group at once, by group_id (list_my_watches shows group_id). It can be restored in the SupaPark app. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

group_id.description: Watch group id (UUID) from list_my_watches: turns off every cell of the group.

name: remove_watch
title: Remove a watch
